arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Queener stated Frye pleaded guilty to a felony charge.
He noted the lawyer failed to inform Frye of a misdemeanor offer.
Mr. Koster argued Frye would have insisted on going to trial.
He claimed Frye knowingly waived his right to a trial.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Galin Frye pleaded guilty to a felony. He claims his lawyer hid a misdemeanor plea offer. The state says he knowingly waived his trial rights.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines how courts handle uncommunicated plea offers. It sets the standard for proving lawyer error caused harm. It impacts how defendants evaluate plea negotiations against trial risks.
